<set-variable name="piiDeanonymizedContentOutput" value="@{
        var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiDeanonymizeContentInput");
        // Pre-process content to replace common encoded symbols
        content = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(content, @"\\u003c", "<");
        content = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(content, @"\\u003e", ">");
        var mappings = JArray.Parse(
            context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiMappings"));

        // <Category_N> and the bare Category_N (e.g. **Person_0**), as a whole word only. Longest
        // placeholders first, so  isn't taken for . Values that go back into a JSON
        // body are JSON-escaped, so a quote or backslash in the original can't break the document.
        var trimmed = content.TrimStart();
        var isJson = trimmed.StartsWith("{") || trimmed.StartsWith("[");
        foreach (var mapping in mappings.OrderByDescending(m => m["placeholder"].ToString().Length)) {
            var original = mapping["original"].ToString();
            var placeholder = mapping["placeholder"].ToString();
            var value = original;
            if (isJson) {
                // JsonConvert isn't allowed in policy expressions: escape by hand
                value = original.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("\"", "\\\"")
                    .Replace("\n", "\\n").Replace("\r", "\\r").Replace("\t", "\\t");
            }
